payload.name: Merge preserves all candidate facts
payload.description: When merging or updating a memory candidate into an existing memory, check that every distinct factual claim in the candidate appears in the merged content before completing the operation.
content: During MERGE or UPDATE, compare the candidate content against the existing memory content.
Identify every non-redundant factual claim in the candidate (e.g., donations, affiliations, causes, preferences).
Ensure each such claim is explicitly included in the merged content; do not let a broad summary omit them.
If the merged content would lose a distinct fact, instead use ADD to create a separate memory or expand the merge content to include all facts.

solves: During construction CRUD, MERGE operations sometimes consolidate a candidate into an existing memory and accidentally drop a distinct factual claim that the candidate had captured, such as a donation target. This skill applies whenever a candidate contains multiple facts and the chosen merge target already has content; it ensures all non-redundant facts from the candidate are preserved in the merged memory.
